args:
# Credential-free first init: no sidecar or runner may start before this passes.
set -eu
: "${NODE_IP:?NODE_IP must come from status.hostIP}"
[[ "$NODE_IP" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] || exit 1
for tool in timeout getent bash sleep python3; do command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || exit 1; done
# DNS deadlines, supervisor cleanup and CI sidecars require working signals.
# Only this short-lived child is addressed; a denied kill expires naturally.
command sleep 0.2 &
signal_probe_pid=$!
if ! kill -KILL "$signal_probe_pid" 2>/dev/null; then
  wait "$signal_probe_pid" 2>/dev/null || :
  echo 'egress-gate: same-container signal contract failed; host must be qualified' >&2
  exit 1
fi
wait "$signal_probe_pid" 2>/dev/null || :
deadline=$((SECONDS + 180))
gate_pid=
watchdog_pid=
cleanup() {
  trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM
  # Monitor mode gives each owned job its own group, never the caller's group.
  if [[ -n "$gate_pid" ]]; then kill -KILL -- "-$gate_pid" 2>/dev/null || :; fi
  if [[ -n "$watchdog_pid" ]]; then kill -KILL -- "-$watchdog_pid" 2>/dev/null || :; fi
  wait 2>/dev/null || :
}
trap cleanup EXIT
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM
run_gate() {
  # Children stay in the gate group so the supervisor can remove the whole tree.
  set +m
  clean=0
  bounded() {
    local remaining=$((deadline - SECONDS))
    (( remaining > 0 )) || return 125
    (( remaining <= 2 )) || remaining=2
    # --foreground prevents timeout from escaping the supervisor's owned group.
    timeout --foreground -s KILL "$remaining" "$@" >/dev/null 2>&1
  }
  tcp() {
    # Socket-level connect timeout: a refused or unanswered connect returns 1
    # without relying on signal delivery; bounded() remains the outer cap.
    # shellcheck disable=SC2016 # Expanded by the probe's bash, not this shell.
    bounded bash -c 'exec python3 - "$1" "$2" <<"PY"
import socket, sys
try:
    socket.create_connection((sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2])), timeout=1.5).close()
except OSError:
    sys.exit(1)
except Exception:
    sys.exit(2)
PY' gate-probe "$1" "$2"
  }
  while (( SECONDS < deadline )); do
    round_clean=true
    # Positive controls prevent disconnected pods or broken DNS passing negatives.
    bounded getent ahostsv4 kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local || round_clean=false
    bounded getent ahostsv4 github.com || round_clean=false
    tcp github.com 443 || round_clean=false
    for endpoint in 10.43.0.1:443 169.254.169.254:80; do
      if tcp "${endpoint%:*}" "${endpoint##*:}"; then
        round_clean=false
      else
        result=$?
        # GNU timeout -s KILL reports 137; setup/exec failures are not denials.
        case "$result" in 1|137) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
      fi
    done
    (( SECONDS < deadline )) || break
    if "$round_clean"; then clean=$((clean + 1)); else clean=0; fi
    if (( clean == 3 )); then
      echo 'egress-gate: three clean rounds; public reachable; cluster API and metadata blocked'
      exit 0
    fi
    sleep 1
  done
  echo 'egress-gate: convergence deadline exceeded' >&2
  exit 1
}
# The watchdog does not depend on timeout delivering any signal.
set -m
run_gate &
gate_pid=$!
(
  set +m
  sleep "$((deadline - SECONDS))" || :
  echo 'egress-gate: convergence deadline exceeded' >&2
  kill -KILL -- "-$gate_pid" 2>/dev/null || :
) &
watchdog_pid=$!
result=0
wait "$gate_pid" 2>/dev/null || result=$?
(( result == 0 )) || exit 1
initContainers.name: egress-gate
